\code{N_MASTERS} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{3} & 1 or more; 4 in the SoC & Number of master ports. The tables show the module default. The SoC sets 4.\\
\code{N_SLAVES} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{2} & 1 or more; 3 in the SoC & Number of slave ports. The tables show the module default. The SoC sets 3.\\
\code{AW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_ADDR_WIDTH} (\code{32}) & 32 in the SoC & Width of an address.\\
\code{DW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_DATA_WIDTH} (\code{32}) & 32 in the SoC & Width of a data word.\\
\code{SW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_STRB_WIDTH} (\code{4}) & \code{DW}/8 & Width of the write strobes. One bit for each byte of a data word.\\
\code{IW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_ID_WIDTH} (\code{4}) & enough bits for the index of \code{N_MASTERS} masters; 4 in the SoC & Width of the ID that the crossbar drives to a slave. The ID is the index of the master. A narrower value drops the upper bits of the index without a message.\\
\code{LENW} & \code{int unsigned} & \code{axi_pkg::AXI_LEN_WIDTH} (\code{8}) & 8 in the SoC & Width of the burst length fields \code{AxLEN}.\\
\code{SLV_BASE} & \code{logic [N_SLAVES-1:0][31:0]} & \code{'0} & one inclusive base address for each slave & Base address of each slave window. It has one 32-bit field for each slave, and the lowest field is slave 0. The SoC passes \code{SOC_SLV_BASE}.\\
\code{SLV_LIMIT} & \code{logic [N_SLAVES-1:0][31:0]} & \code{'0} & one inclusive limit address for each slave & Last address of each slave window. The SoC passes \code{SOC_SLV_LIMIT}. The crossbar keeps the last matching slave when windows overlap.\\
